meta.title: Upload Flights
meta.description: Upload IGC files to add flights to your We-Fly logbook. Drag and drop your paragliding flight files for analysis.

page.title: Upload flights
page.subtitle: Drop your <igc>.igc</igc> tracks here. We'll parse coordinates, compute glide ratios, and place each flight on its takeoff site.
page.privacyNotice: By uploading IGC files, you accept the <policy>Privacy Policy</policy>. Flight data includes GPS coordinates, timestamps and location.

dropzone.title: Drag and drop your flights

dropzone.browseFolderAria: Browse and select a folder containing IGC files
dropzone.browseMoreFilesAria: Browse and select more IGC files
dropzone.browseMoreFolderAria: Browse and select a folder containing more IGC files
